- **Resolution and cost:** It resolved 69% of chats without handoff, behind GPT-6 mini (74%), and cost $0.010 per conversation, between GPT-6 mini ($0.011) and Gemini 3 Flash ($0.008). Llama 5 70B is cheapest ($0.006), but it had the lowest satisfaction (3.9), lowest resolution (61%), and p95 latency above 6 seconds at peak.

- **Decision context:** The pilot team did not reach consensus, and a decision is needed by month end. This recommendation favors customer experience and policy accuracy over resolution rate and cost.

RECOMMEND: Claude Haiku 5.5

- **Containment and cost:** GPT-6 mini resolves the most conversations without a handoff (74%, vs. 69% for Claude Haiku 5.5) at $0.011 per conversation, versus $0.010 for Claude. Llama 5 70B is cheapest ($0.006) but has the lowest resolution (61%), the lowest satisfaction (3.9), and p95 latency above 6 seconds at peak.
- **Accuracy and satisfaction:** Claude Haiku 5.5 has the highest satisfaction (4.3) and the lowest rate of invented refund or fee rules (0.6%, vs. 1.1% for GPT-6 mini). Policy errors matter most in returns and billing, where a wrong promise creates real liability.
- **Integration:** All four connect to the ticketing system. Claude Haiku 5.5 needs a custom adapter for attachments, a one-time engineering cost.
- **Tradeoff:** GPT-6 mini wins on containment, while Claude wins on accuracy and satisfaction. Escalation of angry or legal conversations was above 97% for all four, and the pilot team did not reach consensus. I am Claude Haiku 5.5, one of the candidates, so weigh my recommendation against the figures above.
